verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP registry, hosting and gateway platform, so an official first-party MCP server is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows Glama hosting and proxying third-party MCP servers through its Gateway, plus copy-paste client configs. That is related-but-different infrastructure, and nothing documents an official Glama MCP server that exposes Glama's own capabilities (e.g., registry search) to agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
